name: hash
description: Hashing for Bantu — MD5, SHA-1, SHA-224, SHA-256 and HMAC-SHA256, written in pure Bantu on native 32-bit primitives and bit-exact to the RFC/NIST test vectors. Includes fast non-cryptographic hashes (djb2, fnv1a) and hash_file. MD5/SHA-1 are provided for checksums/interop only and are documented as non-secure.
